verdict.rationale: Recruitee is an ATS, so automated panel and onsite-loop scheduling is a fair axis to judge it on. The only related evidence is a support-site heading about scheduling events and syncing a work calendar. That is basic event scheduling, not automated multi-interviewer panel or loop scheduling, and nothing in the pack covers interviewer load balancing, room booking or conflict resolution.

support.subject: As a recruiter, multi-interviewer panels and full onsite loops schedule automatically — interviewer load balancing, room booking, and conflict resolution included
